# ADR 0003: Consent as a first-class resource checked on every data request

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Secure open banking accounts API

## Context

OAuth scopes say what kind of data a TPP may request, not which customer's accounts or until when.

## Decision

Store consents with permissions, accounts, expiry and status; a single ConsentGuard evaluates every data request against the consent named in x-consent-id and the calling client (azp).

## Consequences

Fine-grained, revocable, auditable access; one place to test. One extra query per request (indexed).

## Alternatives considered

Encoding consent details in token scopes (can't be revoked before the token expires; tokens grow).
